messages:
rachel_finance: Quick follow-up from the AH finance segment — when you said we should "constrain discretionary spend" can you clarify what counts as discretionary for procurement planning?
sam_ceo: Good q. Discretionary = non-customer-impacting hires, vendor renewals without immediate ROI, and new infra projects that aren’t part of the roadmap this quarter. Prioritize customer-facing and safety/compliance spend. :white_check_mark:
maria_fp&a: Adding detail: we expect teams to plan on an 18-month base runway. If you want to accelerate (12-month scenario), flag it with your lead and FP&A — we’ll review tradeoffs.
:information_source: For procurement, use the existing thresholds: < $10k — team lead approval; $10k–$75k — finance + manager; > $75k — exec review + legal.
jordan_eng: For Dedicated infra, does the $75k threshold include multi-month reserved capacity commits?
maria_fp&a: Yes — multi-month commits count as capex/contract value. If it pushes a request over $75k, set up a quick pre-review with FP&A before procurement starts.
rachel_finance: Got it. Is there a fast lane for security or compliance purchases? Some teams have urgent cert/pen test needs.
nina_ops: Yes — security/compliance exceptions go through the security review queue but have a fast-track checkbox. Ping me @nina_ops and I’ll triage within 48h.
sam_ceo: Also, feel free to surface vendor negotiations to procurement early. We have templates and negotiation points that reduce price or add credits (example: 6 months free for year commit).
finance-bot: [automated] Procurement docs: https://confluence.redwood.example/procurement-guidelines — use the request form to capture justification and fallback options.
rachel_finance: For deferred hires: should managers freeze new IC hires now, or can we still backfill critical roles?
sam_ceo: Backfills for revenue, reliability, or customer-facing roles get priority. All other new role reqs need a second-review with FP&A. Keep hiring slow and strategic; we’ll revisit in the quarterly finance sync. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
maria_fp&a: Actionable: teams to submit a 3-line summary for each active procurement/hire by EOD next Friday — consequence: only items with one-line ROI or safety rationale will be advanced.
jordan_eng: Small ask — can we get a one-page checklist for what to include so FP&A reviews faster?
maria_fp&a: Will do. I’ll post a template in the procurement doc and tag all managers when it’s up.
rachel_finance: Thanks — that should help us plan outsourced infra renewals. One more — any guidance on vendor pre-payment credits?
sam_ceo: Treat pre-pay discounts as negotiable; if pre-pay materially improves unit economics, include scenario analysis in the request (show 6/12/18mo cost). If in doubt, loop in finance.
nina_ops: FYI — ops will run a quick spreadsheet to show impact on monthly burn for any pre-pay > $25k.
rachel_finance: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I’ll collate questions and share the 3-line template once Maria posts it. :thumbsup:
